node.label: Caudal interpedicular narrowing
node.definition: Narrowing (becoming gradually narrower) of the distance between vertebral pedicles that gets progressively more severe towards to caudal (lower) end of the vertebral column. Note that normally, the interpedicular distances get progressively wider as one proceeds down the spine.

evidence.snippet: PDE4D haploinsufficiency syndrome: Caudal interpedicular narrowing (frequency HP:0040283) [TAS]
